result.description: The Nimbus Arc 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for color-critical office, creative, and analytical work. It features a 5120 x 2880 IPS panel, 400 nits typical brightness, HDR10 support, and a USB-C hub with 96W power delivery. With a 60 Hz refresh rate and factory-calibrated sRGB and DCI-P3 modes, it is intended for users who want sharp text and accurate color on a single-cable workstation setup.
